description: This source file defines a 'Job' class and related functions for parsing, manipulating, and exporting Gerber and Excellon PCB manufacturing files. It handles reading, processing, trimming, and rotating PCB layer data, including aperture and drill commands, for a PCB design project.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a PCB manufacturing job, including parsing Gerber and Excellon files, managing layer commands, apertures, and drill data, and exporting the data with coordinate transformations.

classes.name: JobLayout
classes.description: Encapsulates a Job with absolute positioning, providing methods to write Gerber and Excellon data at specific offsets, and to generate outline and drill hit visuals.

methods.name: rotateJob
methods.description: Creates a new Job object by rotating an existing one in 90-degree increments, adjusting coordinates, apertures, and drill data accordingly.
